stories.title: Yemen’s Houthis fire ballistic missiles at al-Markha
stories.summary: Yemen’s Houthis fire ballistic missiles at al-Markha Yemen’s Iran-aligned Houthis fired ballistic missiles at Mocha port on Wednesday, a Yemeni army source told Al Jazeera. At least three missiles struck the port area, while a fourth landed near the al-Barah intersection. At least five other missiles hit the al-Khawkhah area of Hodeidah governorate on Yemen’s western coast. The source said the missiles were launched from Houthi-controlled areas east of Taiz.
